title: Fluorescent molecular rotors detect O(6)-methylguanine dynamics and repair in duplex DNA.
authors: Copp, William; Karimi, Ashkan; Yang, Tianxiao; Guarne, Alba; Luedtke, Nathan W
one_liner_zh: 该文利用荧光分子转子检测O6-甲基鸟嘌呤损伤及MGMT修复，虽涉及DNA损伤修复动态，但非TF-DNA结合互作建模，且方法为荧光实验而非AI或物理模拟。
abstract: Alkylation at the O(6) position of guanine is a common and highly mutagenic form of DNA damage. Direct repair of O(6)-alkylguanines by the "suicide" enzyme O(6)-methylguanine DNA methyltransferase (MGMT, AGT, AGAT) maintains genome stability and inhibits carcinogenesis. In this study, a fluorescent analogue of thymidine containing trans-stilbene ((ts)T) is quenched by O(6)-methylguanine residues in the opposite strand of DNA by molecular dynamics that propagate through the duplex with as much as  approximately 9 A of separation. Increased fluorescence of (ts)T or the cytosine analogue (ts)C resulting from MGMT-mediated DNA repair were distinguishable from non-covalent DNA-protein binding following protease digest. To our knowledge, this is the first study utilizing molecular rotor base analogues to detect DNA damage and repair activities in duplex DNA.
abstract_zh: 鸟嘌呤O(6)位点的烷基化是一种常见且高度致突变的DNA损伤形式。通过“自杀”酶O(6)-甲基鸟嘌呤DNA甲基转移酶（MGMT, AGT, AGAT）对O(6)-烷基鸟嘌呤的直接修复维持了基因组稳定性并抑制致癌作用。在本研究中，含有反式二苯乙烯的胸腺嘧啶荧光类似物（(ts)T）被DNA互补链中的O(6)-甲基鸟嘌呤残基通过分子动力学猝灭，该动力学在双链中传播，分离距离可达约9 Å。由MGMT介导的DNA修复导致的(ts)T或胞嘧啶类似物（(ts)C）荧光增强，在蛋白酶消化后与非共价DNA-蛋白质结合可区分。据我们所知，这是首次利用分子转子碱基类似物检测双链DNA中DNA损伤和修复活性的研究。
